text: なんびき　あずけても　ただ　だし　こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！

structure.jp: なんびき　あずけても
structure.en: no matter how many you leave

structure.jp: こまめに　つかうと　いいよ！
structure.en: it's good to use it often!

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: て-form plus も means 'even if'. With なんびき it means 'no matter how many'. なんびき あずけても = 'no matter how many you leave'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a sentence gives one reason among others, 'and besides'. ただだし = 'it's free, and so…'.

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: と plus いい gives a suggestion, 'it would be good if'. こまめに つかうと いいよ = 'it's good to use it often'.
